entities.summary: Léon Levavasseur was a French powerplant engineer, aircraft designer and inventor. His innovations included the V8 engine, direct fuel injection, and liquid engine cooling. Primarily associated with the Antoinette company, he continued to experiment with aircraft design after the company went bankrupt. Léon Levavasseur was a ethicists & moralists from Le Mesnil-au-Val (1863-12-07, Le Mesnil-au-Val–1922-02-26). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
